name: Empowered Professionals of Tomorrow (UVU)
what_you_do: Take real college classes at UVU for seven weeks in the summer. Pick a track in science, engineering, education or business. You earn college credit and meet mentors.
who_can_apply: Utah high school students in grades 9 to 11. The page says it is especially for first-generation college learners.
pay_detail: No pay. Tuition is free for admitted students. You pay for your own rides, lunches and personal costs.
duration: 7 weeks. Tuesdays to Thursdays, 9:00 AM to 3:15 PM (June 24 to Aug 7 in 2026)
deadline_text: The 2026 program was full and had a waitlist. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online. Share your interests, your goals and why you want to join. The application asks for short written responses, which carry strong weight. The team picks students by readiness, interest and fit. Applications can also go on the waitlist.
notes: You must go in person. Classes also have homework outside class time. Track choice is not guaranteed. Questions: text 801-928-7615. The page says you may be added to a contact list for future openings.
